structure.note: One class of common stock. Walton Enterprises, LLC, managed by four WELLCO Mgmt Trusts whose trustees are Walton family members, holds 3,002,673,393 shares and votes another 581,930,458 shares owned by the Walton Family Holdings Trust under an irrevocable proxy, for 44.80% in total. The proxy calls this 'approximately 45%' held by entities related to Sam Walton's family. That is below 50%, so the company is not majority-controlled on these figures.

notes: Fiscal year ended January 31, 2025 (Walmart calls it fiscal 2025; matches data.js fy 'Jan 2025'). Filings are the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0000104169-25-000021) and the 2025 proxy statement (accession 0000104169-25-000055), as of April 11, 2025 with 8,000,886,911 Shares outstanding. All figures were re-read from those EDGAR documents on www.sec.gov on 2026-11-23 (replacing the pilot's stock.walmart.com PDF renderings); cash and stock-comp values are cross-checked against SEC XBRL. FAMILY HOLDING: the proxy lists Walton Enterprises, LLC at 44.80% and the Walton Family Holdings Trust at 7.27%, but the 44.80% already includes the trust's 581,930,458 shares (footnote 4: Walton Enterprises has sole voting power over them by irrevocable proxy). The trust is therefore not listed as a separate holder; adding it would double-count. Individual Walton family members' own holdings (e.g. directors Greg Penner and Steuart Walton in the officers-and-directors table) are not added, because the proxy does not give an aggregate for them and they may overlap with the family entities. VANGUARD: the 5.16% is stale. The proxy bases it solely on a Schedule 13G reporting ownership as of December 29, 2023, split-adjusted, while the percentage uses the April 11, 2025 share count. DIVIDENDS exclude $576 million paid to noncontrolling interest. STOCK COMP: the cash-flow statement has no separate share-based compensation line; the figure is the note total ($2,769 million, which the note also rounds to $2.8 billion), including plans of consolidated subsidiaries granted in their own stock.
